headline: Contested Fronts See Fresh Strategic Exchanges
war_summary: The latest returns show the struggle concentrating along a handful of contested sectors. MooringCountyHex is the immediate hotspot, with six strategic-base events in the past two hours and thirteen over the day; it now stands at eleven Warden-held bases to one Colonial. LinnMercyHex has also quickened, registering six events in two hours and thirteen in twenty-four, while its line remains ten Colonial to one Warden. StonecradleHex records three fresh events in the latest window and fourteen across the day, with five Warden and four Colonial bases. WeatheredExpanseHex remains heavily contested at six Warden to three Colonial, though its thirty-two daily events have gone quiet in the past two hours. StlicanShelfHex, eight to one for the Wardens, has nine events in six hours and twenty-five over the day, but none in the latest two-hour report. FishermansRowHex is presently all Colonial-held, yet its thirty-nine daily events—chiefly at Eidolo, Black Well, and Arcadia—mark it as a useful watch sector despite a quiet recent window. Elsewhere, activity is scattered or negligible. No victor is declared.
